# 📊 NBFC Daily Watch — Thursday, November 12, 2026

Morning edition for Thursday, 12 November 2026 (IST). Covers Wednesday 11 Nov and overnight. Stock and index closes are Wednesday's NSE files.

## 🔴 URGENT / High Impact

### Gold falls for a third session and AGLOC cuts its per-gram ceilings
AGLOC's 85% LTV ceiling for 12 Nov is ₹10,947 a gram, down from ₹11,013 for 7–11 Nov, on a jewellery reference price of ₹12,879 (was ₹12,957). IBJA's 11 Nov PM rate for 999 gold was ₹1,40,603 per 10 g, and Reuters had spot gold down 1.1% at $3,986.79 an ounce on Wednesday afternoon in New York after the hot US CPI print.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the industry's 85% per-gram ceiling is ₹66 lower from 12 Nov, so gold lenders, Muthoot Fincorp among them, have less room per gram on fresh loans, and loans sanctioned at the earlier ceiling sit closer to their cap.
Sources: [AGLOC](https://www.agloc.org/) · [IBJA](https://ibjarates.com/) · [Reuters via New Straits Times](https://www.nst.com.my/business/economy/2026/11/1575844/gold-falls-hot-inflation-figures-higher-dollar-weigh) · [ET Now](https://www.etnownews.com/markets/gold-price-today-november-12-yellow-metal-slips-for-third-straight-session-falls-below-4000-as-fed-rate-hike-bets-rise-article-156496280)

### Bajaj Finance opens a QIP with a ₹992.25 floor price
Bajaj Finance's QIP committee opened a qualified institutions placement on 11 Nov with a floor price of ₹992.25 a share and the option of a discount of up to 5%. Reuters, via BusinessLine, says the board approved up to ₹11,700 crore through the QIP in October; it comes a day after the ₹5,799 crore warrant allotment to Bajaj Finserv.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: two large NBFCs are raising fresh equity in the same week. Muthoot Fincorp's proposed ₹3,000 crore IPO is likely to be compared against freshly capitalised lenders.
Sources: [NSE filing](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/BAJFINANCE_11112026171309_SEintimationopeningofissue.pdf) · [BusinessLine (Reuters)](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/bajaj-finance-launches-11700-crore-share-sale-sets-floor-price-at-99225/article71690436.ece) · [CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/bajaj-finance-launches-qip-with-floor-price-at-rs992-25-per-share-20031765.htm)

### IIFL Finance calls an EGM for 4 Dec; Nirmal Jain puts gold-loan share at about 3%
IIFL Finance has called an extra-ordinary general meeting for 4 December 2026 by video conference, with 27 November as the e-voting cut-off date, to approve the preferential issue. Founder and MD Nirmal Jain told CNBC-TV18 that about 70% of the ₹6,414 crore will go to fresh disbursements and 30% to repaying loans, that its cost of funds is around 9.4%, and that he expects a 25–50 bp cut in borrowing costs in FY28.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: Jain put IIFL's gold-loan book at about ₹65,000 crore, around 3% of a ₹22 lakh crore market, and said leading AA+ gold-loan companies borrow 120–150 bp cheaper. A rating upgrade for IIFL after the deal would mean a better-funded competitor in the gold-loan markets where Muthoot Fincorp operates.
Sources: [NSE: IIFL EGM notice](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/IIFL_12112026004505_SE_Intimation.pdf) · [CNBC-TV18 interview](https://www.cnbctv18.com/business/companies/exclusive-iifl-finance-nirmal-jain-%e2%82%b95000-crore-profit-target-by-fy29-loan-growth-balance-sheet-fundraise-20031218.htm) · [NSE bhavcopy](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/products/content/sec_bhavdata_full_11112026.csv)

## 🏢 Muthoot Fincorp in the market


### Muthoot Fincorp NCD status
Muthoot Fincorp's Tranche I NCDs have been trading on BSE since 11 Nov in the "F" group. No final allotted amount had appeared in a published source by this morning.
| Field | Value | As of |
|---|---|---|
| Status | Closed, 23 Oct – 5 Nov 2026; admitted to dealings on BSE from 11 Nov 2026, "F" group ([BSE notice](https://www.bseindia.com/downloads/UploadDocs/Notices/20261109-30/20261109-30.pdf)) | 2026-11-12 |
| Size | ₹500 crore (₹200 crore base + ₹300 crore green shoe); final allotted amount not seen in a published source | 2026-11-12 |
| Rating | CRISIL AA/Stable; Brickwork AA+/Stable | 2026-11-12 |
| Coupon | 8.56%–9.25% | 2026-11-12 |
| Bids | Bids stood at 2.67x at 17:00 IST on 5 Nov (BSE: 266.83% of base) ([BSE bid data](https://beta.bseindia.com/markets/publicIssues/DisplayIPO.aspx?IPONo=8058&id=4903&idtype=1&startdt=23%2FOct%2F2026&status=L&type=DPI)) | 2026-11-05 |
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the listing step is complete; the deemed date of allotment and the final allotted amount had not been seen in a published source as of this edition.
Sources: [BSE notice 20261109-30](https://www.bseindia.com/downloads/UploadDocs/Notices/20261109-30/20261109-30.pdf)

Muthoot Microfin, Muthoot Fincorp's listed microfinance subsidiary, closed at ₹161.70 on Wednesday, up 1.23% ([NSE bhavcopy](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/products/content/sec_bhavdata_full_11112026.csv)).

## 📈 Market & Stock Summary

### Sensex up 0.95%; IIFL jumps 6.26%, Manappuram slips before results
The Sensex rose 772.75 points to 81,879.40 and the Nifty 50 gained 0.84% to 25,255.05 on Wednesday, while Nifty Financial Services added 1.02% to 27,663.40. Among peers, IIFL Finance closed at ₹666.25 (+6.26%), Manappuram at ₹320.00 (−1.16%) and Muthoot Finance at ₹2,900.00 (−0.60%); NSE's provisional data show FIIs net bought ₹12,563.33 crore and DIIs net sold ₹8,434.53 crore.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the two listed pure gold lenders fell with gold while IIFL rose on its capital raise, a sign the gold fall is feeding into gold-loan valuations ahead of Manappuram's numbers.
Sources: [NSE index closes](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/indices/ind_close_all_11112026.csv) · [NSE bhavcopy](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/products/content/sec_bhavdata_full_11112026.csv) · [NSE FII/DII](https://www.nseindia.com/reports/fii-dii) · [The Hindu](https://www.thehindu.com/business/markets/stock-markets-end-higher-sensex-and-nifty-jump-on-november-11-2026/article71689371.ece)

## 🏛️ RBI & Regulatory — Headlines Only

### RBI consolidates its Domestic Money Transfer Directions; SEBI updates FATCA/CRS reporting
RBI issued the Domestic Money Transfer Directions, 2026 (RBI/DPSS/2026-27/476) on 11 Nov for banks and payment system operators, effective immediately. SEBI told its registered intermediaries to align FATCA/CRS reporting with the Income-Tax Rules, 2026. Details in today's regulation report.
Sources: [RBI notification](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx?Id=13752&Mode=0) · [SEBI circular](https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/nov-2026/reporting-requirement-under-foreign-account-tax-compliance-act-fatca-and-common-reporting-standard-crs-revised-through-income-tax-act-2025-read-with-income-tax-rules-2026_105705.html)

## 💰 Financial Results & Performance

### Manappuram's Q2 FY27 call is at 5 PM today
Manappuram Finance's Q2 FY27 investor call is at 5 PM IST today, and the company says the presentation will be on its website the same day. No Q2 results had been filed on NSE by this morning.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: this is the first pure gold-lender result since gold's fall this week, so its gold AUM growth, auction volumes and Stage 2 trend are a read-across for other gold lenders, including Muthoot Fincorp, whose listed-debt Q2 results fall due by 14 Nov.
Sources: [NSE: Manappuram call intimation](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/MANAPPURAM_05112026222522_prior_intimation_concall_SD.pdf)

## ⚠️ Credit Rating Actions

No significant developments today on Muthoot Fincorp or the gold-loan peers. ICRA's upgrade of Aye Finance is covered in the sector deep dive below.

## 🔄 Deals & M&A

### Foreign capital keeps flowing into NBFCs, Mint reports
Mint lists the recent foreign stakes in Indian lenders: Blackstone's ₹5,000 crore in IIFL, TPG's Rise Funds' ₹525 crore (up to ₹800 crore) in Arka Fincap, MUFG's ₹39,618 crore for 20% of Shriram Finance and Bain's 18% of Manappuram. Equirus Capital's Nirav Shah told Mint that even a 50 bp cut in borrowing costs makes a significant difference to NBFC profitability.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: two listed gold lenders, Manappuram (Bain) and IIFL (Blackstone), now have a large foreign financial investor, and Mint notes that rating upgrades have followed such deals. That is the backdrop for Muthoot Fincorp's proposed IPO.
Sources: [Mint](https://www.livemint.com/industry/banking/from-banks-to-nbfcs-foreign-capital-chases-india-s-credit-growth-11794389152871.html) · [TPG press release](https://www.tpg.com/news-and-insights/kirloskar-backed-arka-fincap-secures-investment-from-tpg-to-accelerate-growth-and-retail-transformation)

## 💻 Digital & Fintech

No significant developments today.

## 📉 NPA & Asset Quality

No significant developments today.

## 👤 Personnel & Leadership

No significant developments today.

## 🏘️ Sector Deep Dive — Thursday: MSME & commercial lending

### ICRA upgrades micro-enterprise lender Aye Finance to A+
ICRA upgraded Aye Finance to [ICRA]A+ (Stable) from [ICRA]A, its second upgrade this financial year after India Ratings in June, the company said in an 11 Nov exchange filing. Aye reports AUM of ₹7,597 crore at 30 September, up 26% year on year, gross Stage 3 down to 4.2% from 4.8% in March, and capital adequacy of 41%.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: Aye lends to micro enterprises, a segment Muthoot Fincorp also serves with business loans; a higher rating and 41% capital adequacy give Aye more room to grow in it.
Sources: [NSE: Aye Finance press release](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/AYEFINANCE_11112026141327_AYE_PressRelease.pdf)

reports.content:
# 📋 NBFC Regulatory Daily Report
**Date:** Thursday, 12 November 2026 (IST)

---

## 🔔 New Regulatory Updates Today

Two instruments landed on 11 Nov. Neither is addressed to NBFCs, but both touch KYC and tax-reporting processes that lenders also run.

### [NEW] RBI consolidates its Domestic Money Transfer Directions
RBI issued the Reserve Bank of India (Domestic Money Transfer) Directions, 2026, which consolidate the existing DMT instructions for banks and authorised payment system operators and take effect immediately. Cash pay-outs stay capped at ₹10,000 a transaction and ₹25,000 a month per beneficiary, and walk-in remitters can send up to ₹5,000 a transaction and ₹25,000 a month through BCs, with registration on a verified mobile number and a self-certified OVD.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: not addressed to NBFCs; it applies to an NBFC only where it acts for a bank or payment operator. The velocity checks and alerts on unusual credit spurts in paras 15–17 describe controls also relevant to cash-heavy lending.
Reference: RBI/DPSS/2026-27/476 CO.DPSS.POLC.No.S843/02-27-019/2026-2027 · Addressed to: scheduled commercial banks (incl. RRBs), UCBs, StCBs, DCCBs, authorised payment system operators and participants · Issued: 11 Nov 2026 · Effective: 11 Nov 2026
Sources: [RBI notification](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx?Id=13752&Mode=0) · [RBI notifications feed](https://www.rbi.org.in/notifications_rss.xml)

### [NEW] SEBI aligns FATCA/CRS reporting with the Income-Tax Rules, 2026
SEBI told registered intermediaries that qualify as Reporting Financial Institutions to follow Rules 238 to 240 and Form 166 of the Income-Tax Rules, 2026, which replaced the 1962 Rules from 1 April 2026. They must update self-certification capture, controlling-person roles, account classification and Form 166 XML generation, and upload FATCA/CRS certifications to the KRAs.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: Muthoot Fincorp is not a SEBI intermediary. Reporting financial institutions outside SEBI's remit report under the same Income-Tax rules and Form 166, so the field changes SEBI lists apply to them as well.
Reference: HO/38/14/(18)2026-MIRSD-POD2/I/25560/2026 · Addressed to: all SEBI-registered intermediaries, stock exchanges and depositories · Issued: 11 Nov 2026
Sources: [SEBI circular](https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/nov-2026/reporting-requirement-under-foreign-account-tax-compliance-act-fatca-and-common-reporting-standard-crs-revised-through-income-tax-act-2025-read-with-income-tax-rules-2026_105705.html) · [SEBI circular PDF](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebi_data/attachdocs/nov-2026/1794392501415.pdf)

### Watchlist sweep: nothing new for NBFCs on 11 Nov
RBI's other 11 Nov releases were money-market operations, T-bill auction results, a G-sec conversion and the money-supply data. SEBI's other items were recovery-proceeding notices and a settlement order. No new IBBI, NHB or FIU-IND instrument turned up in this run.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: no direct change. The dates still open are the 14 Nov Reg 52 results, the 21 Nov Credit Risk-o-Meter start and the 26 Nov PSL comment deadline.
Sources: [RBI press releases](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx) · [SEBI circulars](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebiweb/home/HomeAction.do?doListing=yes&sid=1&ssid=7&smid=0)

cards.title: Gold falls for a third session and AGLOC cuts its per-gram ceilings
cards.summary: AGLOC's 85% LTV ceiling for 12 Nov is ₹10,947 a gram, down from ₹11,013 for 7–11 Nov, on a jewellery reference price of ₹12,879 (was ₹12,957). IBJA's 11 Nov PM rate for 999 gold was ₹1,40,603 per 10 g, and Reuters had spot gold down 1.1% at $3,986.79 an ounce on Wednesday afternoon in New York after the hot US CPI print.
cards.impact: the industry's 85% per-gram ceiling is ₹66 lower from 12 Nov, so gold lenders, Muthoot Fincorp among them, have less room per gram on fresh loans, and loans sanctioned at the earlier ceiling sit closer to their cap.

cards.title: Bajaj Finance opens a QIP with a ₹992.25 floor price
cards.summary: Bajaj Finance's QIP committee opened a qualified institutions placement on 11 Nov with a floor price of ₹992.25 a share and the option of a discount of up to 5%. Reuters, via BusinessLine, says the board approved up to ₹11,700 crore through the QIP in October; it comes a day after the ₹5,799 crore warrant allotment to Bajaj Finserv.
cards.impact: two large NBFCs are raising fresh equity in the same week. Muthoot Fincorp's proposed ₹3,000 crore IPO is likely to be compared against freshly capitalised lenders.

cards.title: IIFL Finance calls an EGM for 4 Dec; Nirmal Jain puts gold-loan share at about 3%
cards.summary: IIFL Finance has called an extra-ordinary general meeting for 4 December 2026 by video conference, with 27 November as the e-voting cut-off date, to approve the preferential issue. Founder and MD Nirmal Jain told CNBC-TV18 that about 70% of the ₹6,414 crore will go to fresh disbursements and 30% to repaying loans, that its cost of funds is around 9.4%, and that he expects a 25–50 bp cut in borrowing costs in FY28.
cards.impact: Jain put IIFL's gold-loan book at about ₹65,000 crore, around 3% of a ₹22 lakh crore market, and said leading AA+ gold-loan companies borrow 120–150 bp cheaper. A rating upgrade for IIFL after the deal would mean a better-funded competitor in the gold-loan markets where Muthoot Fincorp operates.

cards.title: Muthoot Fincorp NCD status
cards.summary: Muthoot Fincorp's Tranche I NCDs have been trading on BSE since 11 Nov in the "F" group. No final allotted amount had appeared in a published source by this morning.
cards.impact: the listing step is complete; the deemed date of allotment and the final allotted amount had not been seen in a published source as of this edition.

cards.title: Sensex up 0.95%; IIFL jumps 6.26%, Manappuram slips before results
cards.summary: The Sensex rose 772.75 points to 81,879.40 and the Nifty 50 gained 0.84% to 25,255.05 on Wednesday, while Nifty Financial Services added 1.02% to 27,663.40. Among peers, IIFL Finance closed at ₹666.25 (+6.26%), Manappuram at ₹320.00 (−1.16%) and Muthoot Finance at ₹2,900.00 (−0.60%); NSE's provisional data show FIIs net bought ₹12,563.33 crore and DIIs net sold ₹8,434.53 crore.
cards.impact: the two listed pure gold lenders fell with gold while IIFL rose on its capital raise, a sign the gold fall is feeding into gold-loan valuations ahead of Manappuram's numbers.

cards.title: RBI consolidates its Domestic Money Transfer Directions; SEBI updates FATCA/CRS reporting
cards.summary: RBI issued the Domestic Money Transfer Directions, 2026 (RBI/DPSS/2026-27/476) on 11 Nov for banks and payment system operators, effective immediately. SEBI told its registered intermediaries to align FATCA/CRS reporting with the Income-Tax Rules, 2026.

cards.title: Manappuram's Q2 FY27 call is at 5 PM today
cards.summary: Manappuram Finance's Q2 FY27 investor call is at 5 PM IST today, and the company says the presentation will be on its website the same day. No Q2 results had been filed on NSE by this morning.
cards.impact: this is the first pure gold-lender result since gold's fall this week, so its gold AUM growth, auction volumes and Stage 2 trend are a read-across for other gold lenders, including Muthoot Fincorp, whose listed-debt Q2 results fall due by 14 Nov.

cards.title: Foreign capital keeps flowing into NBFCs, Mint reports
cards.summary: Mint lists the recent foreign stakes in Indian lenders: Blackstone's ₹5,000 crore in IIFL, TPG's Rise Funds' ₹525 crore (up to ₹800 crore) in Arka Fincap, MUFG's ₹39,618 crore for 20% of Shriram Finance and Bain's 18% of Manappuram. Equirus Capital's Nirav Shah told Mint that even a 50 bp cut in borrowing costs makes a significant difference to NBFC profitability.
cards.impact: two listed gold lenders, Manappuram (Bain) and IIFL (Blackstone), now have a large foreign financial investor, and Mint notes that rating upgrades have followed such deals. That is the backdrop for Muthoot Fincorp's proposed IPO.

cards.title: ICRA upgrades micro-enterprise lender Aye Finance to A+
cards.summary: ICRA upgraded Aye Finance to [ICRA]A+ (Stable) from [ICRA]A, its second upgrade this financial year after India Ratings in June, the company said in an 11 Nov exchange filing. Aye reports AUM of ₹7,597 crore at 30 September, up 26% year on year, gross Stage 3 down to 4.2% from 4.8% in March, and capital adequacy of 41%.
cards.impact: Aye lends to micro enterprises, a segment Muthoot Fincorp also serves with business loans; a higher rating and 41% capital adequacy give Aye more room to grow in it.

cards.title: Two instruments landed on 11 Nov.
cards.summary: Neither is addressed to NBFCs, but both touch KYC and tax-reporting processes that lenders also run.

cards.title: RBI consolidates its Domestic Money Transfer Directions
cards.summary: RBI issued the Reserve Bank of India (Domestic Money Transfer) Directions, 2026, which consolidate the existing DMT instructions for banks and authorised payment system operators and take effect immediately. Cash pay-outs stay capped at ₹10,000 a transaction and ₹25,000 a month per beneficiary, and walk-in remitters can send up to ₹5,000 a transaction and ₹25,000 a month through BCs, with registration on a verified mobile number and a self-certified OVD.
cards.impact: not addressed to NBFCs; it applies to an NBFC only where it acts for a bank or payment operator. The velocity checks and alerts on unusual credit spurts in paras 15–17 describe controls also relevant to cash-heavy lending.

cards.title: SEBI aligns FATCA/CRS reporting with the Income-Tax Rules, 2026
cards.summary: SEBI told registered intermediaries that qualify as Reporting Financial Institutions to follow Rules 238 to 240 and Form 166 of the Income-Tax Rules, 2026, which replaced the 1962 Rules from 1 April 2026. They must update self-certification capture, controlling-person roles, account classification and Form 166 XML generation, and upload FATCA/CRS certifications to the KRAs.
cards.impact: Muthoot Fincorp is not a SEBI intermediary. Reporting financial institutions outside SEBI's remit report under the same Income-Tax rules and Form 166, so the field changes SEBI lists apply to them as well.

cards.impact: no direct change. The dates still open are the 14 Nov Reg 52 results, the 21 Nov Credit Risk-o-Meter start and the 26 Nov PSL comment deadline.
